mapper.select: select id, rule_code, enabled, remind_time, days_before, weekday, rule_version, create_time, update_time from preg_reminder_rule where del_flag = '0' order by id asc
select id, rule_code, enabled, remind_time, days_before, weekday, rule_version, create_time, update_time from preg_reminder_rule where rule_code = #{ruleCode} and del_flag = '0'
mapper.insert: insert into preg_reminder_rule ( rule_code, enabled, remind_time, days_before, weekday, rule_version, del_flag, create_time, update_time ) values ( #{ruleCode}, #{enabled}, #{remindTime}, #{daysBefore}, #{weekday}, coalesce(#{ruleVersion}, 1), '0', now(3), now(3) )
mapper.update: update preg_reminder_rule set enabled = #{enabled}, remind_time = #{remindTime}, days_before = #{daysBefore}, weekday = #{weekday}, update_time = now(3) where rule_code = #{ruleCode} and del_flag = '0'
mapper.select: select max(rule_version) from preg_reminder_rule where del_flag = '0'
